description: Public, source-linked Rock RMS knowledge base for AI agents, maintainers, contributors, model-map lookup, Lava, and operational guidance.
rules: Treat this as public, source-linked Rock RMS guidance; do not infer private church-instance facts from it.
Prefer knowledge/concepts guides, quickstarts, task cards, and agent/answer-pack.jsonl before lower-level build metadata.
Use sources/registry.yaml, source citations, and section source maps to evaluate source authority and citation coverage.
Generated agent, claims, concepts, knowledge, and sources files should be changed through the pipeline, not hand-edited.
Public contributions belong under community-contributions/<org-id>/ or source-suggestions/<org-id>/ until maintainer review.
Never publish secrets, private transcripts, SQL dumps, raw media details, internal IDs, or live-instance evidence.
Model-map pages describe public Rock metadata; verify instance-specific schemas before operational or production changes.
Live-probe recipes are generic read-only patterns; do not perform production writes based only on KB guidance.
For Lava or CMS implementation, confirm Rock version compatibility and public source citations before applying examples.
For public export changes, run audit_tracked_tree.py, validate_bundle.py, kb audit public-export, and relevant tests.
